Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

About the Job

Build the graph that decides who’s real. Every day, Socure’s Identity Graph helps businesses decide whether to trust the person on the other side of a screen. It links billions of signals (names, addresses, devices, emails, phones) into one picture of identity, and it does this in milliseconds. Fraudsters move fast. The graph has to be faster.

As a Staff Engineer on this team, you’ll set the technical direction for the platform behind that decision. You’ll own hard problems end to end, work across Engineering, Data Science, Product, and Security, and see your work shape the products that protect millions of people.

What You Will Do

  • Shape the graph. Define the schemas, relationships, and ontology that make identity data consistent and extensible.

  • Own entity resolution at scale. Decide how records, people, devices, and addresses connect, and how confident we are, across data that is messy, sparse, and sometimes adversarial.

  • Build for speed and volume. Design batch and real-time pipelines, low-latency APIs, and serving systems that hold up under heavy load.

  • Power fraud intelligence. Ship the production systems behind our ML features, model inference, and graph analytics.

  • Move the numbers. Improve performance, reliability, and cost, and prove it with measurements.

  • Set the direction. Lead architecture decisions, document the tradeoffs, and carry initiatives from first design through production rollout.

  • Raise the bar. Mentor engineers and set the standard for design reviews, testing, CI/CD, and operations.

  • Protect identity data. Build privacy, security, and PII protection into every system from day one.

  • Your toolkit: Java, Scala, or Python. Spark, Kafka, Flink, Airflow, and AWS, including EMR. Graph technologies like Neo4j and Amazon Neptune.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field

  • 7+ years building and running distributed systems in the cloud, with at least 2 at Staff or Senior Staff scope, or the equivalent

  • Production scale you can quantify. You can tell us what you built, how big it was, and how much you improved latency, reliability, or cost

  • Deep Spark, Kafka, or Flink experience in both batch and streaming, including debugging them in production

  • Low-latency serving. You have built and tuned APIs where milliseconds matter

  • Graph or entity-resolution experience. You have modeled connected data, matched records across noisy sources, or built an identity graph. Fraud or identity verification is a strong plus

  • Cloud and operations fluency. AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and real production observability

  • ML data pipelines on Databricks, SageMaker, or similar, plus orchestration with Airflow or equivalent

  • Technical leadership. You have led ambiguous, cross-team work, mentored engineers, and changed the direction of a system through design docs and influence, not authority

What This Job is Not

  • It’s not a role for someone who hasn’t owned a system end to end in production, including being on call for it.

  • It’s not feature work on platforms someone else designed.

  • It’s not a defined backlog. You’ll frame ambiguous problems yourself.

  • It’s not a place to treat data privacy as a compliance checkbox.

Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.

Follow Us!

Who We Are

At RelationalAI, we’re solving one of the most important challenges in artificial intelligence: how to teach large language models the logic, semantics, and business context of the modern enterprise.

Frontier models are trained almost entirely on public data — they can speak about the world, but they don’t understand your business. We fix that.

RelationalAI has pioneered a breakthrough called Superalignment — technology that enables LLMs to learn natively from private, structured enterprise data inside the data cloud.

By combining this with relational knowledge graphs and our proprietary neuro/symbolic-relational reasoners, we deliver trustworthy decision intelligence: systems that use semantic models to truly understand how a business operates and can reason across its data to drive better outcomes.

We’re a globally distributed team of engineers, scientists, and builders redefining how AI learns from data. We believe that high-stakes decisions deserve frontier intelligence — intelligence that’s explainable, aligned, and grounded in reality.

If you’re driven by curiosity, thrive in complexity, and want to help build the system that brings true understanding to enterprise AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

The Role

You will be embedded inside our customers' hardest problems, and you will own the outcome until it works in production.

You'll sit with executives, domain experts, and data teams to find the decisions that actually move their business - inventory that's in the wrong place, risk concentrations nobody can see, fraud patterns that only emerge across three systems, capacity plans built on guesses. Then you'll model their world in our ontology, formulate the reasoning problem, write the PyRel, and ship something that runs against their real data in their own Snowflake account.

Every engagement here produces two deliverables.

The first is the one the customer sees: a working decision system that changes how they operate.

The second is the one that matters most to us: the pile of things you had to invent because our platform didn't have them yet. The modelling pattern you hand-rolled. The constraint formulation that should have been a primitive. The three-hour workaround where an API should have existed. You bring those back, you argue for them, and the strongest of them become product.

That second deliverable is why this role exists. If you only ever deliver the first one, we've hired a consultant. We're not hiring consultants.

You'll operate with unusual autonomy: you decide what's worth building, when a workaround is acceptable and when it's technical debt we'll regret, and when to tell a customer their real problem is not the one they asked about. You'll be technical enough that when something breaks in a customer environment, you find the root cause yourself rather than filing a ticket and waiting.

What You'll Do

  • Own outcomes end to end - discovery, modelling, implementation, performance tuning, production hardening, and the measurement that proves it worked. Not a handoff at each stage. Yours.
  • Build, not describe - design and ship decision solutions on our modelling, reasoning, and learning stack: ontologies over customer data, rules, graph analytics, optimisation formulations, predictive models
  • Fill the gaps yourself - when a customer workflow is blocked on something the platform doesn't do, scope it and build it. Then push the general version upstream: read our source, form a hypothesis before you escalate, open the PR.
  • Close the loop with Product - every deployment generates a signal. Bring back reproductions, patterns, and specific failure modes ("the only way I could express this was by abusing X in this way"), not vibes. You are one of the loudest inputs into our roadmap.
  • Run technical discovery that gets to the truth - workshops, demos, and proofs of concept designed to find out whether we can actually solve the problem, not to look impressive.
  • Leave things better than you found them - document as you go, in the repo, same week. Turn one-off work into reusable reference implementations so the next person starts where you finished. No branch of yours should be diverging for a month.
  • Refuse shortcuts that compound - no undocumented config drift, no "it works now" without knowing why it broke, no restarting the service before you've captured the evidence.

Who You Are

You thrive in ambiguity and move with intent. You're motivated by deep understanding and meaningful impact.

  • Owner, not participant. You take full accountability for the outcome, not your slice of it. When something is broken and it's nobody's job, it becomes yours.
  • You build. Your instinct in the face of a hard problem is to open an editor, not a deck. You'd rather show a working prototype on real data than a diagram of one.
  • High conviction, low ego. You argue hard for what you believe, you're direct about what's wrong, and you change your mind quickly when the evidence turns. You challenge ideas without making it personal - people leave arguments with you feeling sharper, not smaller.
  • Rigorous. You root-cause things. You can explain both why it broke and why your fix works. Surface symptoms don't satisfy you.
  • Fast in unfamiliar territory. Dropped into a codebase, a domain, or a data model you've never seen, you're useful within days. "I only do backend" and "that's not my job" are phrases you don't use.
  • High tolerance for friction. Enterprise environments are messy - broken data, VDI access, security reviews, politics. You route around it and keep shipping.
  • Impact-driven. You want the thing you built to still be running, and still be load-bearing, two years from now.

What This Role Is Not

We'd rather be blunt than waste your time:

  • It is not demo-and-handoff pre-sales. You don't disappear after the POC; you're there when it goes to production.
  • It is not staff augmentation. You own outcomes, not hours or ticket queues.
  • It is not advisory. We deliver working software, not recommendations.
  • It is not a support role. You deploy new things; you don't maintain someone else's legacy.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years building and shipping production software, at least some of it inside customer or partner environments
  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership: you have personally taken something from an ambiguous problem statement to running in production, and you can walk us through the whole arc, including what went wrong
  • Strong SQL and deep familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift)
  • Strong programming ability - Python primarily; comfort with declarative or logic-style languages is a real advantage
  • Comfortable reading unfamiliar source code, interpreting stack traces, and debugging systems you didn't write
  • Able to hold your own with both a VP of Supply Chain and a staff data engineer, in the same meeting
  • Comfortable operating in high-autonomy, high-velocity, low-instruction environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Built analytical, decision, or reasoning applications that reached production and stayed there
  • Experience with optimization, constraint solving, rule engines, graph algorithms, or ML on structured data
  • Semantic modelling, data pipelines, and governance in real enterprise settings
  • Track record of upstream contribution - features, tools, or abstractions you built for one customer that became standard for everyone
  • Prior experience in enterprise technology, AI, or analytics platforms

How We Hire

Our loop is designed to test the job, not trivia. Expect a technical screen; a session where you navigate and extend a system you've never seen before; a problem-decomposition session on a realistic customer scenario; and a conversation about ownership with the hiring manager. We're looking for how you think when you don't know the answer.

The Solution Engineer position offers a base salary range of $170,000 to $200,000, along with equity and comprehensive benefits. Please note that this range serves as a guideline; actual total compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, skill set, qualifications, and geographic location.

Why RelationalAI

At RelationalAI, you will:

  • Work from anywhere in the world
  • Earn competitive salary + equity
  • Enjoy open PTO, flexible schedules, and recharge weeks
  • Access global benefits, mental-health support, and learning stipends
  • Join a transparent, inclusive, and globally connected culture that values curiosity, excellence, and impact
  • Regular team offsites and global events – Building strong connections while working remotely through team offsites and global events that bring everyone together.
  • A culture of transparency & knowledge-sharing – Open communication through team standups, fireside chats, and open meetings.

Country Hiring Guidelines:

RelationalAI hires people from around the world. All of our roles are remote; however, some locations might carry specific eligibility requirements.

Because of this, understanding location & visa support helps us better prepare to onboard our colleagues.

Our People Operations team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruitment process.

How to Apply

If you’re driven by understanding, powered by curiosity, and ready to help shape the next era of enterprise intelligence — we’d love to hear from you.

Join us and help build the reasoning layer for the modern enterprise.

Built over eighteen years of meta-data and ontology engineering, Collibra governs context and control across any data storage system, AI model, and AI agent. A 5x Forrester Wave Leader and 2x Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, Collibra serves more than 700 customers, including 78 of the Fortune 500, and governs more than 2 billion assets.

Collibra Public Sector is a FOCI-mitigated entity with a DCSA facility clearance. Collibra Public Sector personnel service clients in some of the most demanding mission organizations. Collibra Public Sector products, people and partners are uniquely positioned to deliver software and services solutions to the US federal market.

Join Collibra Public Sector

Collibra is looking for a proven General Manager to create and execute the overall business strategy to achieve long-term profitable growth that outpaces competitors and peers. Responsibilities include recruiting and leading a high-performing team that integrates sales, consulting services, support, legal, operations, marketing, product management, and product delivery. The General Manager will set the direction for the subsidiary to comply with government-required mandates such as CMMC. The General Manager will identify untapped market areas and build plans to capture those opportunities.

Successful outcomes

  • Operate as a true GM leading sales, services, support that aligns parent-company dependencies into a single, accountable operating rhythm
  • Optimize post-sales execution by driving consistent deployments, adoption, and renewal readiness across Public Sector accounts
  • Manage overall expense to revenue targets
  • Spend the company’s money wisely to invest in new opportunities
  • Work closely with the parent to drive the overall Public Sector product roadmap and align any support needed from the shared services teams
  • Maintain positive evaluations from relevant government agencies such as DCSA

Characteristics

  • Create a culture of trust and accountability within Collibra Public Sector
  • Know when to build consensus and when to maintain autonomy
  • Bold risk-taking based on deep understanding of complex data
  • Politically astute when dealing with diverse stakeholders and conflicting demands

Experience

About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is seeking a Sr. Director, Enablement to join our Revenue team. This position will report to the VP, Revenue Operations and Enablement. The Revenue Operations and Enablement team is responsible for sales strategy, technology, and enablement. The Sr. Director, Enablement will build a repeatable enablement framework to systematically support all segments of LaunchDarkly’s Revenue Organization. This role will ensure that all customer-facing personnel have the knowledge, content, skills, processes, and behaviors needed to optimize every interaction with buyers. The role will also oversee the planning and execution of Revenue Organization events, including SKOs.

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with leadership experience in a revenue-focused organization where enablement is integrated into every interaction. They bring deep experience developing enablement programs, supporting ongoing employee development, and implementing the processes and tools required to build a world-class enablement function.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the multi-year revenue enablement strategy and roadmap, aligned to GTM priorities, with quarterly outcomes tied to ramp time, win rate, and quota attainment.
  • Lead and grow a global team of enablement leaders and specialists, setting clear priorities, coaching for excellence, and operating as a player-coach where needed.
  • Architect role-based onboarding and continuous readiness for all revenue roles (Sales, Sales Managers, SEs, CS, BDR/SDR, PAMs), covering product, process, messaging, and selling skills, including pitch certification, with ramp metrics tracked from day one.
  • Equip teams to win with technical buyers by developing playbooks, talk tracks, objection handling, and competitive messaging for developer, platform engineering, DevOps, and engineering leadership personas, and by owning the sales playbook for Land & Expand motions, including New Logo and Expansion plays.
  • Own the enablement track for the annual GTM kickoff and quarterly business reviews, with full oversight of content and readiness.
  • Modernize the enablement tech stack (LMS, CMS, sales engagement, conversation intelligence) and embed AI into seller workflows to accelerate productivity, coaching, and deal execution, while maintaining a company-wide content map that serves as a single source of truth for the field.
  • Partner with the CRO, VP Sales, VP CS, Product, Product Marketing, and Partner leaders to align messaging, qualification frameworks, and customer journey execution, and advise GTM leadership on readiness and change management for new initiatives.
  • Build dashboards and reporting that link enablement to GTM outcomes (rep, PAM, and SDR productivity, internal satisfaction, completion), using data to prioritize investment and retire programs that don't move the number.
  • Define and drive the partner enablement strategy, aligned with internal enablement programs and GTM motions.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years combined in sales and sales enablement at enterprise SaaS companies, including 5+ years in leadership.
  • Track record of scaling onboarding and enablement in a high-growth environment.
  • Deep expertise in core enablement disciplines: value selling, sales process and methodologies, coaching, skill development, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to partner across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Solution Engineering, and Product to build a culture of alignment.
  • History of designing and launching partner enablement programs.
  • Skilled at creating learning content and shaping a unified communications strategy that keeps the field informed and aligned.
  • Prior work in a GTM strategy role, with a strong grasp of how enablement connects to revenue planning.
  • Success planning and executing large-scale events, such as global sales kickoffs.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence at every level, including executive leadership.
  • Nice to have:
    • Time spent carrying a quota in a selling role.
    • Leadership of a sales-related function, such as Sales Development, Inside Sales, or Enterprise Sales.
    • Familiarity with enterprise technology companies serving the developer space.
    • Hands-on work developing competitive programs, buyer personas, and customer reference programs.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level M5:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $240,600 - $330,700**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $216,500 - $297,600*
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $204,500 - $281,100**
  • All Zones Inclusive of 20% Bonus Target

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at hr@launchdarkly.com.

Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @LaunchDarkly.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. If you are ever unsure about a communication that you receive, don't click any links—visit Careers | LaunchDarkly directly for confirmed job openings and links to apply.

Please notify us of any fraudulent representation by sending an email to careers@launchdarkly.com.

About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

Sitting within Corporate Marketing, the SEO & AEO Manager owns Juniper Square's visibility across organic search, AEO, and GEO: how we're found, ranked, and cited, in traditional search and in the AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) that GPs and fund operations teams increasingly use to research vendors and ideas. Working across the broader GTM organization, you'll set the strategy, then own execution end to end, from technical foundation to AI visibility to authority building.

GPs come to Juniper Square for software, for fund administration services, or increasingly both, and each entry point carries its own nuance (terminology, competitive set, audience expectations, etc.) so your strategy has to flex across the full platform rather than run one generic playbook. AEO and GEO add another layer: there's no industry-established playbook yet, and you're expected to help write one for Juniper Square rather than just execute someone else's. The right candidate uses AI as standard infrastructure and pairs technical rigor with the discipline to build processes that compound over time.

The application deadline for this role is October 5th, 2026.

What you’ll do

Own Technical SEO
Success here means organic traffic and rankings grow measurably against a defined set of priority terms across Juniper Square's full platform.

  • Own SEO across junipersquare.com: on-page optimization, site architecture, internal linking, Core Web Vitals, and regular technical audits, partnering with our web engineering agency to scope and ship fixes.

  • Monitor and improve sitewide crawl efficiency and indexing. Manage structured data (JSON-LD) and emerging AI crawling protocols, including llms.txt and plain-text/markdown alternates of priority pages.

  • Own the brief and quality bar for agency and vendor relationships across SEO, AEO, and content production, deciding what stays in-house.

  • Monitor Juniper Square's rankings against named competitors, in both traditional search and AI answer engines. When a competitor overtakes us on a priority term, diagnose why and drive the fix, whether that's a technical change, a content update, or an authority play.

Win Citations Across the Open Web

Success here means Juniper Square gets cited by name in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Google AI Overviews for the private markets questions that matter, tracked against named competitors.

  • Optimize content for LLM and AI-search visibility: schema and structured data, answer-first formatting, and semantic reinforcement that makes Juniper Square content easy for AI systems to extract and cite.

  • Extend that visibility beyond junipersquare.com to Reddit threads, YouTube (titles, descriptions, chapters, and metadata built to rank in video results), review sites, and other community content LLMs treat as trusted sources, and direct that content to work for two readers at once, crawlers and humans, using AI-assisted workflows to scale production without lowering the quality bar.

  • Contribute to the broader social content strategy, including LinkedIn, so format and structure support search and AI-citation goals across channels, not just engagement.

  • Run controlled experiments to isolate what actually moves AI citations rather than treating AEO as guesswork, and turn what you learn into a repeatable playbook.

  • Track how AI platforms retrieve, summarize, and attribute Juniper Square content, report regularly on citation share alongside organic traffic and rankings, and use that data to reprioritize the roadmap.

  • Treat technical SEO and GEO as one program with shared priorities instead of running them as separate workstreams.

Build Category Authority

Success here means referring domains and citations from private markets and financial media keep growing: real evidence Juniper Square is gaining authority on private markets ideas, not just its own product terms.

  • Build Juniper Square's authority on the ideas that define private markets, not just on product and brand terms, so we're the source search engines and AI systems point to on GP operations, fund administration, and other core private markets topics.

  • Tailor authority-building work to how a GP is engaging us, whether that's software, fund administration, or both, since the competitors and publications that matter shift with the entry point.

  • Partner with content and subject-matter experts to identify where Juniper Square should be the definitive answer to a private markets question but isn't yet, and close those gaps.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in SEO, including hands-on ownership of a technical SEO program at a large B2B organization.

  • Real, hands-on AEO/GEO experience, not just familiarity with the concept. You should be able to point to a specific citation you've earned in an AI answer engine and explain exactly how you did it.

About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We're looking for a SDK Engineer - Python to join our SDK team and own how developers talk to Supabase from Python. You'll work closely with the rest of the SDK team, our Auth, Realtime, Storage, PostgREST, Functions, CLI and Docs teams, and the open-source community, helping us make the Python SDK a library Python developers genuinely enjoy using.

Python developers reach Supabase from backend services, data pipelines, notebooks, and a growing number of AI agents and agent frameworks. The Python SDK is how all of them talk to the platform: database queries, auth, storage, realtime and edge functions, in both sync and async flavors.

This is a library-authoring role, and the work happens in the open: public repos, public issue trackers, and API decisions whose consequences last for years. If you get satisfaction from a type checker that catches the bug before your users do, from an async client that cleans up after itself, and from an issue tracker that isn't a graveyard, you'll like it here.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Build and evolve our Python SDK across database, auth, storage, realtime and functions, with both sync and async APIs that feel natural in Python.

  • Start new things. Alongside the maintenance work, find what's missing, make the case for it, and build it. Nobody will hand you the list.

  • Work in the open. Triage inbound issues, review and shepherd outside contributions, keep CI and release automation healthy, and hold a clear, kind line on scope.

  • Own the typing experience. Make the SDK fully typed and checker-friendly, so autocomplete and static analysis stay correct in real codebases.

  • Keep us honest across environments. Multiple Python versions, sync and async frameworks, workers, serverless and notebooks — with dependency ranges that don't fight our users' projects. Test it, don't assume it.

  • Work on realtime. Long-lived websocket connections, reconnection, and subscription and presence semantics.

  • Track the platform. When auth, realtime, storage, postgrest or edge functions ship a change, make sure the SDK reflects it, and that we say so in the changelog.

  • Design in public. Write the RFCs, migration guides, release notes and docs. Treat a breaking change as a deprecation path plus a migration story, not a version bump.

  • Make our SDK legible to AI coding agents, which are now a major consumer of it.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

  • Know modern Python typing deeply. You use generics, protocols, overloads and TypedDict as design tools, run strict type checking, and fix type errors without reaching for Any.

  • Have authored or maintained a published library with a public API and users outside your own company. You know what it costs to change something people depend on.

  • Know the maintainer side of open source. Issue triage at volume, reviewing outside PRs, release automation, changelogs and semver, security reports, and saying no to a feature request without losing the person who asked.

  • Are fluent in asyncio and have opinions on how a library should serve both sync and async callers.

  • Know Python packaging for libraries: pyproject.toml, wheels, modern tooling, version support policy, and why libraries shouldn't pin their dependencies tightly.

  • Test as a habit: unit, type-level and end-to-end against a real stack. Every fix comes with a regression test.

  • Write well. Design docs, changelogs and issue replies are a large part of the output here, much of it public, and we're async by default.

  • Have real autonomy: you find the important work, scope it, ship it, and say what you didn't do.

  • Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Have experience in async or globally distributed teams

  • Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly

Bonus points if you: have run a major-version migration for a public package, know your way around JWT/OAuth, have built integrations for AI agent frameworks, or have generated idiomatic clients from a schema.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

  • Drive Reliability & Resilience: Establish testing and reliability standards, SLAs (uptime, RTO, RPO), and disaster recovery playbooks. Lead major reliability initiatives to minimize downtime and protect critical business data.

  • Accelerate and Empower Data Access: Develop self-service tools, frameworks, and automation that reduce manual effort, improve efficiency, and enable teams across engineering, analytics, and data science to work effectively with data while minimizing dependency on the Data Platform team.

  • Contribute to Strategic Planning: Partner with Technical Program Managers to define and refine strategic roadmaps, ensuring that data engineering priorities align with business objectives.

  • Drive Cross-Team Collaboration: Collaborate with Staff Engineers and technical leaders across domains to identify friction points, and work collectively to design solutions that improve system reliability, consistency, and scalability.

Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

About the Role

Social is one of the most visible surfaces of the LP brand, and it's ready for a strategic owner. You'll set the direction for how LP shows up across every platform, from LinkedIn to Reddit, and turn that presence into a real growth channel rather than a content calendar that runs on its own.

This is a build role. You'll define the strategy, prove that social drives pipeline, and make the function a reliable partner to the rest of marketing. You'll work closely with our CEO on his thought leadership presence and with content, demand gen, and sales on campaigns that need social to land.

What You'll Do

  • Build and publish a documented social strategy within your first 90 days: channel priorities, content pillars, posting cadence, and voice guidelines, reviewed quarterly against performance data.

  • Own a quarterly social-sourced pipeline target, set jointly with sales and RevOps, and build the reporting that shows a clear line between social activity and business results.

  • Grow share of voice for LP's core narrative through follower growth, reach, and impressions on flagship content, including our CEO's thought leadership and our Reddit presence.

  • Manage community health end to end: engagement rate, response time, and sentiment, with a clear before-and-after benchmark from your first day.

  • Make social a dependable contributor to at least one other function's goals within your first year, such as the newsletter's social section, video series distribution, or webinar promotion, with a documented handoff process.

  • Own real-time judgment calls. Reddit threads and comment sections move fast, and there's no playbook for every scenario. You'll decide when to engage, when to escalate, and how to protect the brand without waiting for direction.

What We're Looking For

Skills and Experience

  • 4-6 years in social media or community management, with at least 2 years owning strategy rather than executing someone else's calendar.

  • Deep working knowledge of how platforms actually behave, not a one-size-fits-all approach to LinkedIn, Instagram, Reddit, YouTube, and TikTok.

  • Comfortable pulling and interpreting engagement, reach, and conversion data, and adjusting strategy based on what the numbers say.

  • Strong brand voice discipline. You can make LP sound like LP everywhere, including in fast-moving, informal spaces like Reddit.

  • Hands-on content creation or art direction skill, whether that's producing content yourself or briefing designers and videographers effectively.

Attributes

  • You operate as a strategic owner of the function, not an execution arm. You spot opportunities and act on them rather than waiting to be asked.

  • You have strong judgment under ambiguity. When something goes sideways in public, you own it end to end.

  • You hold a high quality bar even at volume. Social is often a prospect's first touchpoint with LP, and you know sloppy content undercuts the brand.

  • You work fluidly across functions. Social touches nearly everything else in marketing, and you're comfortable coordinating with content, demand gen, sales, and leadership.

  • You stay ahead of platform shifts and cultural moments instead of catching up to them weeks later.

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

About the Team

An instrumental part of GOAT Group, the Marketing team oversees a wide range of activities, which aim to build awareness, consideration and loyalty for our brands. As a member of this team, you will work to execute thoughtful, data-driven marketing campaigns that drive meaningful growth for the company.

Role Overview

GOAT Group is seeking a Sr. Performance Marketing Specialist to run our paid social and video acquisition strategy. You will own and operate Meta, TikTok, and YouTube Ads. You will also develop the creative testing roadmap and leverage incrementality to measure performance. This role reports to the AVP of Growth.

We expect AI fluency in practice. As targeting, bidding, and placement have moved inside the platforms’ models, creative has become the main lever you control. Leveraging AI tools for strategic research and automating operations will be key to success. Much of our process is being automated through internal AI workflows, so this role will have more emphasis on workflow oversight.

In this role, you will:

  • Run day-to-day paid social and video across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube: campaign build, budget pacing, audience and placement setup, and optimization against incrementality KPIs.
  • Plan and execute the creative testing roadmap — write briefs, launch tests, experiment readouts.
  • Leverage AI tools (Claude, Gemini, internal workflows) for strategic research and operations. You'll partner closely with the AVP of Growth to continually develop and improve AI workflows.
  • Build and maintain the weekly and monthly creative performance marketing reports.
  • Partner with Brand and Creative on asset needs, turning performance reads into specific, useful creative direction.
  • Run structured tests — holdouts, geo splits, incrementality reads — supporting the AVP of Growth, and interpret the results honestly against platform-reported numbers.
  • Flag new formats, placements, and platform features worth testing, and make the case for trying them.

How Success Is Measured

  • Incrementality. To truly understand the performance of our efforts, we rely on incrementality methods, such as geolift. We then leverage platform metrics as multipliers based on the measurement outcomes for daily operational KPIs.
  • Creative performance. Leverage platform metrics to build creative narratives to explain how they performed and what we should do next.
  • Operational reliability. Campaigns should launch accurately and on time. With AI automated more operations, this person must be have final oversight before campaigns launch.

We are looking for:

  • 3+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and/or YouTube Ads.
  • Experience with incrementality and/or MMM to measure true lift or causal performance.
  • Comfort working in performance data — pivot tables, dashboards, and enough rigor to catch a number that looks wrong before it reaches a deck.
  • AI fluency in practice. You use LLMs and AI tooling in your daily workflow for briefs, copy variants, creative iteration, and reporting, and you can tell us specifically what it changed about your output and what you had to watch for.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can explain a result, including a disappointing one, to people who do not live in the ad platforms.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in a marketplace, resale, ecommerce, or DTC business.
  • Familiarity with creative automation tooling such as Motion, Pencil, Smartly, or AdCreative.
  • SQL, or experience pulling your own data from a warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery.
  • Exposure to affiliate networks, creator-commerce platforms, or TikTok Shop.
  • Mobile app install campaign experience, including MMPs such as AppsFlyer or Branch.
  • Interest in or knowledge of sneakers, streetwear, and resale marketplaces.

Alliances & Channels Leader

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We have new senior leadership opportunities in our Global Alliances and Channels organisations, to lead business development and partnership with some of the most important actors in the global technology sector. As the publisher of Ubuntu and a leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, Canonical works across a broad partner ecosystem that includes global system integrators, value-added resellers, regional distributors, independent software vendors, independent hardware vendors, silicon companies, public clouds and other strategic technology brands.

These partners shape the platforms, solutions, marketplaces, hardware and delivery motions through which enterprises adopt open source at scale. We are looking for exceptional partner leaders who can build durable, mutually valuable relationships, develop joint solutions, drive global go-to-market programmes, and convert partner potential into measurable customer impact, revenue growth and market expansion for Canonical.

Opportunities are available for both people leaders and senior individual contributors. In these roles, you will lead, build or scale one or more strategic partner motions for Canonical, either by managing a team or by directly driving high-impact partner initiatives. You will work closely with partners throughout their sales, product, delivery and executive planning cycles to make Canonical their trusted partner for enterprise open source solutions. Depending on your experience and Canonical’s business priorities, your focus may include Channels, GSI, ISV, IHV/OEM, Silicon, Cloud or cross-ecosystem partnerships.

Our Alliances and Channels teams build trusted relationships with partners at executive level, increase Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelise the partnership, and lead business interactions from engineers to CxO level. This role will own strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions across assigned partners or sectors, as well as promotion of partner-related activities, from campaigns, enablement and executive engagement, to strategic opportunities and partner events.

Location: These are globally remote positions.

The role entails

  • Own and drive partner strategy, forecast, bookings and revenues for Canonical across one or more indirect routes to market
  • Lead and evolve a team or strategic partner portfolio towards accelerated revenue growth and market impact
  • Build strategic relationships with global and regional partners at executive levels
  • Design and execute joint go-to-market plans with partners, sales, product management, product marketing and engineering teams
  • Develop partner capability through sales engagement, technical enablement, joint marketing and disciplined business planning
  • Guide our offering from product management, to product marketing, and scale it through the support of our global sales organisation
  • Establish operating cadence, pipeline governance and data-driven accountability across complex partner relationships

What we are looking for in you:

  • 10+ years of experience in alliance, channel, partner, ecosystem or indirect sales management roles
  • Experience in one or more of GSIs, VARs, distributors, ISVs, IHVs/OEMs, silicon, public cloud, marketplaces or strategic technology alliances
  • Deep commercial experience encompassing revenue, margins, pipeline, forecasting and partner economics
  • Proven leadership and presentation skills, with the ability to engage confidently from engineer to CxO level
  • Ability to build trusted executive relationships while aligning product, sales, marketing, engineering and operations teams
  • Insight into open source, Ubuntu, enterprise infrastructure, cloud, AI, security and Canonical’s competition and opportunities
  • Track record of data-driven decision-making and disciplined execution across complex, global relationships
  • An autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.
  • Business level written and spoken English.
  • Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.
  • International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.

In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:

  • Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.
  • Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.
  • Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.
  • Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Why This Role Matters

Every OTP SMS, enterprise marketing message, and API-triggered communication travels through routing groups owned and maintained by this team. As a Technical Routing Analyst, you will own the day-to-day quality and cost performance of global SMS and voice routing, ensuring traffic is delivered reliably, efficiently, and at the best possible margin.

What You Will Do

  • Monitor and respond to quality alerts (SMSCR, DLR Success Ratio, Rejected/Undelivered, Queue, Bind-down) via Zendesk and Tableau, following established investigation processes
  • Provide 24x5 follow-the-sun routing assurance coverage in rotation with regional peers
  • Perform proactive quality assurance across SMS and voice destinations — identifying degraded suppliers and initiating route changes
  • Manage country-level routing: evaluate supplier performance against cost and quality targets and implement tiered routing decisions
  • Onboard and test new supplier connections (SMPP/MM4/MM7 protocols) in coordination with Connectivity Operations
  • Identify and escalate carrier degradations, encoding errors, and throughput issues, coordinating resolution with CORT and suppliers
  • Contribute to automation initiatives that improve supplier onboarding times, cost management, and quality alerting
  • Participate in regional handover processes and maintain clear handover notes for the next-shift team
  • Support the migration of SMS services from IBM Data Centres to AWS

  • Solid understanding of SMS routing fundamentals — SMPP protocol, DLR codes, encoding, conversion rates, and delivery ratio metrics
  • Experience working with carrier or telco routing systems and monitoring tools (e.g. Tableau, Zendesk, or equivalent)
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to investigate degradation patterns, cross-reference data sources, and drive root-cause resolution
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, 24x5 operational environment with on-call responsibilities
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to coordinate clearly across time zones with suppliers and internal stakeholders
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with carrier, product, and engineering teams

Role Description

As Director of Pricing and Packaging at Dropbox, you will lead the strategy that determines how we package, price, and monetize our products across product-led growth (PLG) and sales-led growth (SLG) motions. Reporting to Head of Product Marketing, you will lead a small team and partner closely with Product, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Data Science, and senior executives to make pricing and packaging a durable driver of customer value and profitable growth.

This is a highly visible opportunity to help reinvent Dropbox’s monetization approach as we expand our sales-led business and build for the AI era. You will develop a holistic pricing and packaging architecture across products, customer segments, and routes to market—balancing customer adoption, competitive positioning, revenue growth, cost to serve, and margin. You will translate complex analysis into clear strategic choices, build alignment among senior leaders, and establish the capabilities and operating rhythms needed to make consistently strong monetization decisions.

You will have significant exposure to Dropbox’s senior leadership team and the opportunity to shape some of the company’s most consequential growth decisions. Your work will directly influence how customers experience and value Dropbox, how our products go to market, and how the business grows over the long term.

Responsibilities

  • Define and lead Dropbox’s company-wide pricing and packaging strategy across PLG and SLG motions, customer segments, product portfolios, and geographies.
  • Design the next generation of Dropbox’s packaging and monetization architecture, including approaches for AI-powered products and capabilities, while balancing customer value, adoption, revenue, cost to serve, and margin.
  • Build rigorous business cases and financial models to evaluate pricing and packaging opportunities, incorporating demand, willingness to pay, competitive dynamics, usage patterns, unit economics, and potential customer and revenue impacts.
  • Partner with Product, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Data Science, and Operations leaders to translate strategy into executable plans, including research, experimentation, rollout, enablement, measurement, and iteration.
  • Advise senior executives on high-impact monetization decisions by synthesizing complex quantitative and qualitative evidence into clear recommendations, tradeoffs, and decision frameworks.
  • Establish pricing and packaging governance, operating rhythms, performance metrics, and experimentation practices that improve the quality and speed of decision-making across Dropbox.
  • Lead, develop, and inspire a small team of pricing and packaging professionals while expanding the organization’s broader monetization capabilities.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in pricing, packaging, monetization, growth strategy, strategic finance, product strategy, management consulting, or a related discipline, including substantial experience in B2B SaaS.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing pricing or packaging strategies that produced measurable business or customer outcomes.
  • Experience with both product-led and sales-led business models, including an understanding of their distinct customer journeys, routes to market, and monetization considerations.
  • Experience building pricing business cases and financial models that connect customer behavior and willingness to pay with revenue, cost to serve, unit economics, and margin.
  • Working knowledge of SaaS and AI monetization models, including subscription, seat-based, usage-based, consumption-based, and hybrid approaches.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence executive-level decisions and align senior cross-functional stakeholders around complex, high-impact initiatives.
  • People-management experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing team members.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a major pricing or packaging transformation for a multi-product or global SaaS company.
  • Experience developing monetization strategies for AI-powered products, including evaluating inference or infrastructure costs, usage economics, value metrics, and margin implications.
  • Experience managing the intersection of self-serve, enterprise, and partner-led offerings within a shared product portfolio.
  • Experience with pricing research and experimentation methods such as conjoint analysis, willingness-to-pay research, price elasticity analysis, customer segmentation, or controlled testing.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

  • Customer-Inspired: You’ll help your team educate the market on the power of Salesloft and turn what enterprise buyers tell you into sharper deals and coaching.

You’re a results-oriented, strategic leader who builds and coaches enterprise Account Executive teams to win net new business, and who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.

  • Worked self-directed and resourcefully, with a strong work ethic and willingness to go the extra mile.
